card.name: Storage wording and brand-name continuations
card.fires_on: Mixed spots in drug labels: linking words in storage instructions (for, from, under after temperatures or 'Protect'), and the middle of capitalized brand names split into pieces.

modes.label: Storage linking words
modes.description: Small words like for, from or under right after a temperature or storage phrase.
modes.example: the partially used vial refrigerated at 2°C to 8°C [36°F to 46°F] in the original carton<< for>> use within 28 days

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: A letter chunk partway through an all-caps brand name repeated in the text.
modes.example: LEGY ELLIPTA slowly. ( 5.8 ) • If paradoxical bronchospasm occurs, discontinue TRELEGY<< E>>LLIPTA and institute alternative therapy

modes.label: Digits in phone numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a phone number or web contact line.
modes.example: S with documentation of safe use. Further information is available at www.XYWAVXYREMREMS.com or 1-866-9<<9>>7-3688.
